On March 14th 1998 at RoundhayPark, Leeds, Lee Hurst became holder of the Parker Bowl, awarded to the first Belgrave man home in the 'National'. Lee had a fine run to place30th in 47:07 with the race won by Shaftesbury Barnet's Dominic Bannister in 44:45. Other Belgrave placings in a field of 1661 finishers were: 252, G.Adams 52:05; 294, M.Webb 52:45; 439, P.Carstairs 54:30; 804, D.Anderson 58:47. Will Lee be first Belgravian again in 1999?
